column7: One command per write: 0004h stop, 0008h start, 0040h reverse, 0080h forward, 0200h manual.
column15: bit 2 = Stop (per P04); bit 3 = Start; bit 6 = Set reverse (needs P17 = 2); bit 7 = Set forward; bit 9 = Manual mode (use keypad speed register)

column7: First of a 6-register status block; read 6 registers from here.

column6: Run status (AC Tech register 26, low byte)
column7: Low byte = operational status code; see values.
column15: 0 = Fault lockout; 1 = Fault; 2 = Start pending; 3 = Stop; 4 = DC brake; 5 = Run at 0 Hz; 6 = Run; 7 = Accel; 8 = Decel; 9 = Current limit; 10 = Decel override; 11 = Lower transistors switching on

column7: 0 unlocks control only; password (default 225) also unlocks parameters.
Example of the parameter rule: register = parameter + 51.
